I'm finishing the write-up from what I've gathered. Several pages could not be fetched because the proxy refused the connection, so some facts below come only from search-result summaries. I left out every result dated after 2026-08-13.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance ^N225 daily close for 2026-09-03, a Thursday and a normal Tokyo trading day. I could not load Yahoo directly. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EN225/)
- 2026-08-12: the code baseline shows a latest Yahoo close of 67,524.06. CNBC reports the same figure, up 0.83%, with the Topix up 0.94% at 4,139. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-08-13: CNBC and FRED both report the Nikkei up 1.16% at 68,308.59, with the Topix up 0.89% at 4,176.04. This is the newest close as of the cutoff. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/12/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/nikkei225)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. There are about 14 trading sessions left after the 08-13 close.
- 2026-08-13: the index, at about 68,300, sits roughly in the middle of the 50,000-85,000 question range. It is about 5.6% below the record and about 11% above the late-July low.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-13: the index gained 1.16%, its second straight up session. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/12/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-08-12: Tokyo reopened after the Mountain Day holiday on 08-11 and rose 0.83%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- 2026-08-10: close of about 66,970. [note.com market report](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ncb031d2f0747?hl=en)
- 2026-08-07: Xinhua reported that Tokyo stocks ended mixed. I could not open the article. [Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20260807/dcefea1cb363485bb2f90d67524a1b05/c.html)
- 2026-08-06: according to the search summary, SoftBank fell about 6% before its earnings and was more than 30% below its year-to-date high, while the yen weakened. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/08/06/nikkei-225-index-on-edge-ahead-of-softbank-earnings-as-japanese-yen-dips/)
- July 2026: the index fell 8.13% to 64,362.02, its first monthly drop in four months. The July high was 70,474.96 on 07-01 and the low was about 61,434 on 07-29. Nikkei's monthly report blames caution after fast gains, worries about AI and semiconductor competition, and renewed Middle East tensions. [Nikkei newsletter vol80](https://indexes.nikkei.co.jp/nkave/archives/file/nikkei_indexes_newsletter_vol80.pdf)
- 2026-06-25: record close of 72,366.34. The index first closed above 72,000 on 06-22. [Nikkei vol79](https://indexes.nikkei.co.jp/nkave/archives/file/nikkei_indexes_newsletter_vol79.pdf), [Jiji/Adnkronos](https://english.adnkronos.com/2026/06/22/nikkei-closes-above-72000-for-1st-time/)
- 2026-05-13: first record close above 63,000. [Adnkronos](https://english.adnkronos.com/2026/05/13/nikkei-225-hits-record-closing-high-above-63000/)

## 4. Base rates
- Code baseline: 15-session percentiles from 67,524 (3-year empirical returns, with the last year weighted double):
  - p5: 62,864
  - p10: 64,344
  - p25: 66,733
  - p50: 69,018
  - p75: 71,718
  - p90: 73,223
  - p95: 74,096
- The 08-13 close was already about 1.2% above that baseline's starting level, and one fewer session remains.
- How big recent moves have been:
  - From 07-01 to 07-29, the index fell about 13% (70,475 to 61,434).
  - From the late-July low to 08-13, it rose about 11%.
  - Moves of 1% or more in a day are common. The index is volatile, and the chip stocks Advantest and SoftBank carry very large weights in it.
- Trend: a strong rise through late June, a sharp fall in July, then a partial recovery in August.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the Nikkei 225 close for 2026-09-03.
- I found no recent broker or strategist target that applies to this short a horizon.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-03
- Late August: Nvidia quarterly earnings, usually in the last week of August. These are a big driver for Advantest, SoftBank and Tokyo Electron, and so for the Nikkei.
- Late August: the Fed's Jackson Hole symposium (usually the last full week of August), US PCE inflation, and Tokyo CPI for August (end of month).
- Ongoing: the USD/JPY level and the risk of Japanese currency intervention. A weaker yen tends to lift the Nikkei, and intervention or hawkish Bank of Japan signals tend to hurt it. The next BOJ policy meeting is in September, probably after 09-03, so hike expectations matter before then.
- Ongoing: Middle East tensions and oil prices, which Nikkei's own report cited as a July headwind.
- After resolution, so irrelevant: the US August jobs report, normally the first Friday of September (09-04).
